blocks.text:
The tour includes Botero Plaza and the Museum of Antioquia, followed by the elegant Rafael Uribe Uribe Palace of Culture and historic Veracruz Church. The experience continues in Comuna 13, now celebrated for its colourful murals, lively streets, outdoor escalators and vibrant urban culture, offering an insight into the remarkable transformation of the neighbourhood. To conclude the day, visit El Castillo Museum, an elegant European-style mansion surrounded by landscaped gardens and home to a collection of fine art, antiques and period furnishings.

Return to the hotel.
A cobbled square with a white church and colourful houses in Medellín, Colombia

blocks.text: Breakfast at the hotel. After breakfast, private transfer to the airport with your driver for your flight to Cartagena de Indias, one of the best-preserved colonial cities in the Americas and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Upon arrival at Rafael Núñez International Airport, you will be welcomed by your private English-speaking guide, who will accompany you throughout your stay in Cartagena. In the afternoon, discover Cartagena, where colonial architecture, history and Caribbean charm come together. Explore Bocagrande, Castillogrande and Manga before visiting La Popa Monastery and San Felipe de Barajas Castle.
